fixed_or_addressed.finding: FSDP checkpoint full-state all-gather gated under rank==0
fixed_or_addressed.notes: All training-loop checkpoint calls now enter save_fsdp_checkpoint on every rank and pass rank through; rank 0 remains the only file writer.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: FSDP optimizer state saved as rank-local optimizer.state_dict
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Uses FullyShardedDataParallel.optim_state_dict on save and optim_state_dict_to_load on load, with an explicit warning fallback for unsupported/runtime-failing PyTorch combinations.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: FSDP gradient clipping uses local-shard torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_
fixed_or_addressed.notes: FSDPTrainer now clips through the wrapped model's clip_grad_norm_ method when available.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: FSDP AMP uses plain GradScaler
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Uses ShardedGradScaler when the installed PyTorch exposes it, falling back to GradScaler only for compatibility.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: FSDP MixedPrecision hardcoded fp16
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Added mixed_precision_dtype/param_dtype/reduce_dtype/buffer_dtype aliases while preserving the old fp16 default.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: FSDP gradient checkpoint wrapper uses default reentrant checkpoint with kwargs
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Checkpoint wrappers now pass use_reentrant=False.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: DDP standard train loss not all-reduced
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Training total/base/regularization losses are reduced across ranks before reporting.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: DistributedSampler seed not tied to experiment.seed
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Standard and FSDP distributed samplers now receive the experiment/trainer seed.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: Standard/sequence dataset random_split unseeded or fixed to 42
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Added split_seed threading and explicit split generators for MNIST/Fashion/CIFAR/ImageNet/sequence splits.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: StringerV1 normalization leak and non-disjoint state-specific overlap
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Train/test Stringer normalization uses train-split stats; state-specific all-vs-subset overlaps are rejected; state-specific test can reuse train stats.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: Lorenz linear observation matrix differs between train/test
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Added observation_seed independent of trajectory seed; the factory shares it across train/test.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: PoissonGenerator uniform multiplicative gain crashes with no gain factor
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Uniform gain now defaults to identity gain; non-uniform gain without a bound raises a clear ValueError.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: ImageNet subset first-per-class and unseeded split
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Per-class subsets are seeded random samples and train/valid split is generated with split_seed.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: Indexed sparse seed=None ignores experiment/global seed
fixed_or_addressed.notes: seed=None derives from the process/global torch RNG, so experiment set_seed controls indexed morphology.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: Indexed TopK + conductance_dynamic forward-hook scaling AttributeError
fixed_or_addressed.notes: IndexedSparseLinear and IndexedDynamicTopKLinear now implement register_forward_param_gradient_scale.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: BlockLinear softplus decay inverse overflow
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Softplus decay/boost now uses the shared stable inverse_softplus.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: conductance_power<1 floors tiny nonzero conductances
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Exact zeros are guarded without clamping sub-epsilon nonzero magnitudes upward.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: SklearnEstimator reports mean feature-wise MI for multivariate X
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Multivariate continuous/discrete and continuous/continuous paths now call joint nearest-neighbor estimators instead of averaging per-feature sklearn scores.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: Fisher proxy double-converted to bits and multiclass proxy unweighted
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Fisher proxy keys are excluded from nats-to-bits conversion; multiclass between/within variances are class-count weighted; binary covariance uses population variance.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: Compartment SNR single-feature pinv/cov failure
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Single-feature multivariate SNR now uses the scalar d'^2 formula and population variance.

fixed_or_addressed.finding: Noise perturbation and compartment-statistics analysis unseeded RNG
fixed_or_addressed.notes: Added analysis seeds and explicit torch.Generator usage.

intentionally_deferred.finding: TopK input_scale dead work and redundant stored scale attributes on forward-hook path
intentionally_deferred.reason: Performance cleanup only. Removing these attributes could affect the legacy non-forward-hook gradient-scaling path; left for a narrower cleanup after profiling.
